_comment: The field keys that hold a CURRENT time or date — the wall clock — as opposed to a
SCHEDULED one the operator authors (service.time '10:30 AM', next.time, feat.time,
midweek.time, game.clock). The distinction decides two things, and they were allowed
to drift apart, which is the bug this file exists to prevent:
1. inject-shim-v2.cjs drives `shimDrives` live on boards that have no clock engine
of their own (42 boards shipped the current time as literal text — every church
2. PropertiesPanel treats `time` + `date` as BOARD CONFIG, so the editor offers the
clock control (timezone, 12/24h) instead of a free-text box holding a stale
authored value. clock.hhmm (76 boards) was missing from that list, so boards whose
clock ticked correctly on screen still showed '10:42 PM' in a text field.
`shimDrives` is deliberately NARROWER than `time`+`date`: clock.hhmm and the today.*/
menu.* families already tick from the board's own engine, and two engines writing one
node would fight. Widen it only after checking the board does not self-drive.
